blurb: WILLIAMS CREEK GOLF COURSE Williams Creek Golf Course is an 18-hole, par-3, championship course located just two miles from downtown Knoxville. Our facility features daily fee golf, tournaments, lessons, clinics and junior golf opportunities including the nationally recognized First Tee program. Williams Creek Golf Course offers a challenging and rewarding experience for players of all levels.
